annotations.title: インボイス登録番号が有効か確かめる

description: Check whether invoice registration numbers (適格請求書発行事業者の登録番号, T + 13 digits) are valid, for one or many numbers at once (up to 20). Typical use: verifying the T-number printed on an invoice or receipt before claiming input tax credit (仕入税額控除). Without `date`, checks validity as of today (JST) and also returns the registered name so the user can compare it with the invoice. With `date` (e.g. the invoice issue date), checks validity on that date; the name is not returned in that mode. A number with only 13 digits is treated as a T-number. Invalid or unknown numbers are reported per item and do not fail the whole call. Uses 1 API request per number.

date.description: この日付時点で有効だったかを判定する（YYYY-MM-DD、2024/10/1 なども可）。省略時は今日
